tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Read usage for the Frontier bearer API key on this MCP HTTP request.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_usage" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Read usage for the Frontier bearer API key on this MCP HTTP request.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_capabilities · Private data: get_usage · Public sink: get_usage.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_capabilities · Private data: get_usage · Public sink: get_usage

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
